dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive linear narrowing from the mid-lateral section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and largely symmetrical lateral margins with no significant deviations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, fine-grained dark specks distributed primarily across the cephalic and anterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between pigment zones across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent, dark longitudinal linear mark located on the posterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible blowhole depression; no unnatural shadow-casting deformations or blunt trauma indentations visible.

dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct longitudinal linear mark/scar on the posterior dorsal surface.
